# Runtime Asset Manifest

The level map references production image slots below. The current Phaser scene is wired so these paths can be filled with the supplied art exports without changing gameplay code.

- `backgrounds/forest_bg.png` — Forêt Luminescente background inspired by `téléchargement (3).jpg`.
- `backgrounds/forest_trees.png` — Forêt Luminescente parallax tree layer.
- `tiles/forest_ground.png` — forest ground tiles.
- `backgrounds/temple_bg.png` — Ruines du Temple Singe background inspired by `téléchargement (4).jpg`.
- `tiles/temple_brick.png` — temple brick tiles.
- `backgrounds/waterways_bg.png` — Canalisations Royales background inspired by `Royal Waterways.jpg`.
- `tiles/waterways_floor.png` — waterways floor tiles.
- `characters/hero.png` — hero artwork supplied in the prompt.
- `enemies/zombie.png` — zombie/goblin archetype artwork supplied in the prompt.
- `enemies/dragon.png` — dragon/forest-spirit boss archetype artwork supplied in the prompt.
